title: KrisFlyer Spontaneous Escapes Deals for August 2026
body:
Australian Frequent Flyer
Australian Frequent Flyer - Tips, Tricks and Chat for Australian Frequent Flyers
Towards the end of each month, Singapore Airlines offers discounted KrisFlyer Saver Awards for travel in the following month. Photo: Singapore Airlines.
The KrisFlyer Spontaneous Escapes deals are a monthly staple of Singapore Airlines’ frequent flyer program.
Each month, Singapore Airlines normally offers 30% off the KrisFlyer miles required for last-minute award flights on a range of different routes. You can use these to book Saver awards at Promo rates in Economy, Premium Economy and Business Class, for travel during the following month.
Singapore Airlines has just released its Spontaneous Escapes deals for August 2026. Until 31 August 2026, you can get 30% off the KrisFlyer miles on selected award flights for travel during September 2026.
This month’s promotion includes flights from Darwin, Perth, Brisbane, Cairns, Melbourne and Sydney to or from Singapore. Also, it includes flights to various destinations in Asia, USA and Europe, plus two fifth freedom flights between Frankfurt to New York and Los Angeles to Tokyo.
Regional Business Class on the Singapore Airlines Airbus A350-900. Photo: Matt Graham.
After the 30% Spontaneous Escapes discount, as an example, you could book a Business Class seat from Singapore to Darwin for just 29,750 KrisFlyer miles + taxes.

KrisFlyer Spontaneous Escapes T&Cs
The KrisFlyer Spontaneous Escapes discounts apply on point-to-point flights to/from Singapore. If you’re connecting through Singapore onto another flight, you’ll also get a discount if both flights in your itinerary are eligible for a discount.
If only one sector in a multi‑sector itinerary qualifies for a discount, the Singapore Airlines compares the combined price of the two individual flights with the regular through‑fare and charges whichever amount is lower.
KrisFlyer does not allow changes or refunds on Spontaneous Escapes award bookings.
You’ll need to book on the Singapore Airlines website and must take all flights within the promotional period to access the discount. Some blackout dates may apply and no stopovers are allowed. When booking online, the Singapore Airlines website shows discounted seats as “Promo” awards:
Discounted award seats are marked as “Promo” awards on the Singapore Airlines website.
Discounted KrisFlyer Awards for August 2026
KrisFlyer has released its latest Spontaneous Escapes deals on the Singapore Airlines website , for travel during September 2026. You must book and pay for your ticket by 31 August 2026 to access the 30% discount.
